content: अनुव्रज् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To follow, go after; तां व्रजन्तीमनुवव्राज <ls>K. 132</ls>, <ls n="K.">210</ls>; attend especially a departing guest (as far as the bank of water, lake, <ab>&c.</ab>) as a mark of respect; अतिथिं श्रोत्रियं तृप्तमासीमान्तमनुव्रजेत् <ls>Y. 1. 113</ls>; तं मातरो देवमनुव्रजन्त्यः <ls>Ku. 7. 38</ls>; यमिच्छेत्पुनरायान्तं नैनं दूरमनुव्रजेत् <ls>Rām. 2. 40. 50</ls>. .²2 To visit in order, seek. .²3 To go to or near; betake oneself to; मृगा मृगैः सङ्गमनुव्रजन्ति <ls>Pt. 1. 282</ls> deer herd or associate with deer. .²4 To obey, to do homage to.
